description: SwiftUI view for configuration settings in a macOS application, including UI components for displaying and editing configuration sections, subsections, and schemas.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view struct for configuring application settings, managing state and view presentation logic.

classes.name: ConfigSection
classes.description: Represent a configuration section with key, label, help text, and schema node.

classes.name: ConfigSubsection
classes.description: Represent a subsection within a configuration section, with associated schema node and path.

classes.name: SubsectionSelection
classes.description: Enum to track which subsection is active, either all or a specific key.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer for ConfigSettings, optionally accepting a ChannelsStore.

methods.name: body
methods.description: SwiftUI View body that constructs the main view layout with sidebar and details.

methods.name: resolveSections
methods.description: Resolves sections from the schema node, applying UI hints and humanizing keys.

methods.name: resolveSubsections
methods.description: Resolves subsections within a section, with sorting based on hints.

methods.name: resolvedSchemaNode
methods.description: Resolves the effective schema node, handling 'anyOf' and 'oneOf' variants, ignoring null schemas.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Converts snake_case or kebab-case strings into human-readable labels.
